summary:
风衣街角. An adult fashion model wears the referenced trench coat at a quiet stone street corner in soft overcast daylight.

retention_analysis:
Transfer the adult identity from Picture 1 and garment construction from Picture 2. Picture 3 defines the final composition. Keep face, hem length, seams and accessories consistent.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Full-body editorial fashion shot. The adult model from Picture 1 wears the exact garment from Picture 2, as dressed in Picture 3. Take two slow grounded steps, turn the shoulder slightly, reveal hem and sleeve construction, and settle back into Picture 3 composition. Cloth responds to body motion, no independent flutter. No spoken words. Single continuous shot. Complete the important action within the intended edit and leave a brief stable handle at the end. No text overlays, watermarks or added logos.

overall_soundscape:
Soft footsteps and natural fabric movement; no speech.

non_diegetic_music:
Minimal editorial percussion.
